mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the two routes was most worthwhile: the arrows made it clear that one full lap passes through the heart twice.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to connect the lung route directly to the left heart was confusing because their labels matched, but the combination was not available yet.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the labelled lung return could not connect immediately; the left heart first needed its body route.

arbitrary.text: The prerequisite for connecting the two routes felt arbitrary: the labels suggested the earlier pairing should work, but the result did not explain why it could not.

continue.text: I would continue to another chapter. Building the full circuit and seeing the heart muscle's separate supply made me curious about how other body systems connect.
